why_agent_cannot: an X account post or follow is required
what_human_must_do: Open beta.pursuit.games , which pursuit.games links to, and join the waitlist with your email. You can add your X handle.
Share your friend link if you want to move up the line. "Codes go out in waves."
Wait for your code by email, or reply to Pursuit's 5 November post on X , which invites people to ask for a code there. Some codes are also posted by @pursuitsportsgg.
Sign in with a passkey, a wallet, X or email, pick a manager name and enter your code. A wallet is created for you.
costs: The waitlist and the beta are free, and the beta needs no deposit or gas. At mainnet, packs will be sold. The launch post says: "Rip packs, build your lineup, and compete in weekly contests for prizes." Pack prices aren't published. risks: No terms of service, privacy policy or company name is published, and pursuit.games/terms returns an error page. Prize rules, eligible countries and age limits aren't written down anywhere we found. The waitlist collects your email and, if you add it, your X handle, with no privacy policy saying how they are used. Nothing is promised.
